coverage: LLVM source coverage in libcutl 1.10.0's XML pull parser (cutl/xml) and the pinned Expat 2.10.0 it runs in namespace mode (external Expat, as Debian builds libcutl)
api: cutl::xml::parser(std::istream&, input_name, receive_elements | receive_characters | receive_attributes_event | receive_namespace_decls) over a std::istringstream of the local bytes; next() until eof; qname().namespace_()/name() for start_element and start_attribute, value() for characters (inside start_attribute/end_attribute: the attribute value), start_namespace_decl events for xmlns declarations
scope_limit: cutl::xml::parser is a pull-event wrapper over Expat's namespace mode: element and attribute qnames carry the URI Expat resolved and xmlns declarations arrive as start_namespace_decl events. The adapter formats these events and sorts attributes per element as in the other C++ paths; it resolves nothing. Comments and processing instructions are not reported by the parser. Only the cutl/xml component (with cutl/exception.cxx) is compiled, against the pinned Expat 2.10.0 as an external Expat, matching Debian's +ds1 repack, which removes the bundled Expat subset; Expat's hash salt is left at its default (random per parser).
